baseline_rule: Production statewide votes must be within 2% of staging.
candidate_completeness_rule: Staging must be within 25 votes or 0.01% of the raw office total.

disposition_rules.map_inspection: Winner flip, >=5pp margin delta, or >=25% district vote-placement delta with >=500 votes.
disposition_rules.review: 2-5pp margin delta, or >=1pp with at least half of linked urban votes allocated by historical plan cell.
disposition_rules.no_outlier_detected: No material outlier under these thresholds.
disposition_rules.candidate_map_review: Incomplete old baseline; directly review a candidate district dominated by linked urban plan-cell votes.
disposition_rules.candidate_internal_checks_passed: Incomplete old baseline; staged statewide total reconciles to raw results.
disposition_rules.fallback_allocation_review: Large change has no direct linked urban vote and belongs to the unmatched-vote fallback audit.
disposition_rules.production_calibration_review: Production used a manual margin override and is not a clean geometry baseline.
